services.name: Kayaking Classes
services.desc: Back by popular demand! Are you a modern Mark Twain? If so, come with us to Northeast Iowa and experience the Mississippi River from your kayak. The river offers breathtaking beauty and numerous chances of viewing wildlife. Let our experienced guides assist in basic river paddling techniques, river navigation through a Lock and Dam, and vehicle shuttling. Come experience the Mississippi River in a short weekend getaway. Friday Night: Meet at campground and set up camp. Guides will review the weekend itinerary and address any weather/water level related changes. Sit back and relax around a campfire and get rested up to paddle!​ Saturday: Guides will help arrange shuttle and gear to Marquette

services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: Enjoy the end of the day on the water watching the sunset. Paddle with a guide around Blue Heron Lake watching the day fade. Information and stories will be shared about how and why sunsets are so beautiful, hear fun facts about local wildlife, and hopefully see some birds and animals along the shoreline. We will stop on a beach along the way for a s’more break while admiring the sunset. Participants need to dress ready to paddle, bring a beverage for on the water, and a camera to capture the sunset! blurb: Welcome to the Raccoon River Park Boathouse located on Blue Heron Lake in West Des Moines, IA. We have been offering non-motorized boat rentals since 2020 and have a selection of kayaks, canoes, paddleboat, stand up paddle boards, fishing kayaks, and bicycles. We are excited to offer the options of; renting boats on Blue Heron Lake and the Raccoon River, as well as renting bicycles for the trails around the park.
